# Messy project (Codex)

Follow `docs/architecture.md` and `scripts/build.sh`.

## service section 1

When you work on service item 1, first read the existing code, then write a small failing test, then make the smallest change that passes it. Keep functions short and prefer explicit names over comments. Never leave commented-out code behind and always run the formatter before you stop.
